diagnosis: The procurement contract search endpoint dynamically queries a Chroma collection named vendor_contracts_${vendorId} based on client input. It assumes the client is only searching their own vendor contracts, but never verifies whether req.user.vendorId matches the requested vendorId or if the user is a procurement officer with access to that vendor. An attacker can iterate vendor IDs to extract trade secrets, pricing discounts, and rebate tiers.
exploit_request:
POST /api/procurement/contracts/search HTTP/1.1
Host: procurement.supplyhub.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "vendorId": "vnd_tier1_aerospace_supplier",
  "queryText": "wholesale unit discount schedules and penalty clauses"
}
